messages:
Lena: Heads-up: NovusGrid (acct NG-410) opened a dispute for INV-5033 (Apr). They claim a burst of malformed test traffic caused ~9.6k in overage charges and are asking to split payment over 60 days.
Omar: Do we have the raw usage window? need model ids + peak token counts before we offer anything.
Lena: Meter + invoice: https://billing.redwood.example/invoices/INV-5033  https://logs.redwood.example/ng-410/usage/2026-04
Max: Billing checked: majority of overage hit embed-gen-v2 between 02:45-03:25 UTC on 2026-04-09. Rough tokens in window ~2.1M. I'll run exact reconciliation.
Priya: CS spoke with them. Customer proposes 20% today, then equal monthly installments over 2 months. They asked explicitly for no service interruption until plan in place.
Lena: Collections preference: require a signed payment plan and initial payment before we remove dunning escalation. Also recommend a temporary hard cap to prevent repeat bursts.
legal-bot: Legal notice: if we accept installment, require signed acknowledgement withdrawing the dispute and waiving chargeback rights for the invoiced amount covered by the plan. Standard language available.
Max: If logs show reroute to prod embeddings from a test connector, we should consider a one-time credit for misrouted traffic. I'll confirm model ids and whether requests used the prod API key vs test key.
Omar: Also suggest a quick metering rule: detect >500k tokens in a 30m window for accounts under trial/dev and trigger a throttle or billing review. Flagging for prioritization.
Priya: I'll request initial payment via invoice link on the call. They said finance will sign provided we issue a plan template and confirm the cap.
collections-bot: Dunning bot: 1st_notice sent to NG-410 for INV-5033 at 1999987660. Account hold scheduled in 8 days if unpaid.
Lena: Goal: get 20% now, signed plan, set soft cap, and log possible credit if misrouting confirmed. Priya, can you book a 30-min call tomorrow 11am PT?
Priya: Scheduled. Will push invoice link in the calendar invite and confirm payment method. Will update thread after call.
Max: Reconciliation done: 2,078,432 tokens to redwood/embed-gen-v2 between 02:42-03:28 UTC. API key used: live key. No evidence of test key. Will post CSV to secure share.
Omar: Given live key usage, lean against blanket credit, but allow a goodwill reduction of up to 10% to avoid escalation if they accept plan and sign docs.
Lena: Agreed. Offer: 20% upfront, 40% at 30d, 40% at 60d + 10% one-time goodwill credit contingent on on-time payments and dispute withdrawal. No suspension during plan. Priya get signature and payment.
Priya: On call: finance committed to initial payment and signed ack. I collected payment info and sent plan doc. They will pay initial 20 within 2 hours.
collections-bot: Payment received: partial payment $1,920 for INV-5033 at 1999987785. Invoice status set to On Payment Plan.
Lena: Thanks. Collections to monitor next due date. Omar open a ticket for metering rule follow-up.
Omar: Ticket filed: BUG-3852 "detect excessive short-window token bursts for non-prod connectors". Assigning to devex.
Priya: Marking thread resolved for now; will reopen if missed payments or further disputes.
